answer: Proof-of-work identity activation puts a sable lantern at the door: a fresh identity burns a little compute to prove it is real, and each further identity from the same wallet faces a steeper puzzle than the last. A sybil farm would need a timber of rented GPUs, and the electricity bill alone would eat every reward the fakes could earn. Honest entry stays an onyx trickle; mass fakery drowns in its own cost.
